August 15, 2024 - X-Large is an American streetwear brand and clothing store based in Los Angeles, California. It was founded by Eli Bonerz and Adam Silverman in 1991, based on an idea from Mike D. Since then, the company has expanded the business in New York City, Tokyo, Seattle, and Toronto, among others.
